profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Enterprise Applications • Systems Integration • Automation & DevOps
profile.summary:
Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of experience designing, developing, integrating, deploying, and supporting enterprise applications and internal business systems.
At Brooks Construction, I work across the application lifecycle—from understanding business needs and designing technical solutions to development, systems integration, deployment, production support, and ongoing improvement. My work supports construction operations, accounting, HR/payroll, scheduling, field reporting, asphalt production, quality control, and other business functions.
My experience includes PHP/CodeIgniter, JavaScript, Node.js, React, Python, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, REST APIs, WebSockets, Linux server administration, AWS, CI/CD, and application diagnostics. I also work extensively with integrations and data workflows connecting internal applications with enterprise platforms including CMiC, Viewpoint Spectrum, B2W, SSRS, plant-control systems, and third-party services.
As my role has grown, I've taken on increasing technical ownership of application architecture, implementation decisions, deployment automation, production troubleshooting, and developer support. I enjoy understanding how a business process works and determining how technology can make that process more efficient and reliable.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Develop, integrate, deploy, and support enterprise applications and internal business systems for Brooks Construction.
 
• Serve as a primary developer of HQ, Brooks Construction's custom enterprise operations and integration platform supporting numerous business functions.
 
• Translate business requirements into technical solutions, independently determining application workflows, interfaces, data structures, and implementation approaches.
 
• Develop scheduling and resource-planning systems, including interactive Gantt-based tools supporting crews, materials, and jobs.
 
• Build integrations and automated workflows connecting HQ with CMiC, Viewpoint Spectrum, B2W, plant-control systems, INDOT e-ticketing, HaulHub, SSRS, internal databases, and third-party APIs.
 
• Administer Linux/Webmin application servers and support Apache/PHP configuration, updates, permissions, scheduled services, backups, DNS/hostname configuration, and performance troubleshooting.
 
• Designed and implemented CI/CD automation that replaced manual FTP deployments with Git branch-based deployments across application environments.
 
• Developed internal application-diagnostic and IT support tooling that captures browser, request, and user-interaction information to improve production troubleshooting.
 
• Serve as a primary technical resource for other developers on application architecture, implementation, codebase questions, and troubleshooting.

positions.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Developed and supported custom internal web applications, integrations, databases, reporting solutions, and automation supporting construction operations and business processes. Worked extensively with PHP/CodeIgniter, JavaScript/jQuery, SQL, Python, and enterprise data systems while expanding responsibilities across our internal platform.

positions.title: Chromebook Support Specialist/ Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed web applications and tools supporting faculty workflows and internal university processes.
 
• Created and maintained technical documentation and supporting websites for IT systems and services.
 
• Provided Tier 1 technical support through Jira and assisted with user and account administration using Active Directory and PowerShell.
